{
  "proposals": [
    {
      "rationale": "Add an explicit exception unit for paragraph (a)(3)(i) qualifying C0002, specifying that the prohibition on possessing wine, beer, or distilled spirits while on duty or operating a commercial motor vehicle does not apply when manifested and transported as part of a shipment.",
      "operation": "add",
      "target": "",
      "qualifies": ["C0002"],
      "quote": "(i) Manifested and transported as part of a shipment; or",
      "fields": {
        "concepts": [
          {
            "label": "Alcohol Possession Exception - Manifested Shipment",
            "definition": "An exception to the prohibition against possessing alcoholic beverages while on duty or operating a commercial motor vehicle when the alcohol is manifested and transported as part of a shipment.",
            "quote": "However, this does not apply to possession of wine, beer, or distilled spirits which are:\n\n(i) Manifested and transported as part of a shipment",
            "role": "rkaf:assignmentPrimary"
          }
        ],
        "claimants": [],
        "typed_values": [],
        "effective_periods": [],
        "defined_terms": [],
        "term_refs": [],
        "kind": "exception",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "However, this does not apply to possession of wine, beer, or distilled spirits which are:"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Applies as an exception to the prohibition against possessing wine, beer, or distilled spirits while on duty or operating a commercial motor vehicle.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "(3) Be on duty or operate a commercial motor vehicle while the driver possesses wine of not less than one-half of one per centum of alcohol by volume, beer as defined in 26 U.S.C. 5052(a), of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954, or distilled spirits as defined in section 5002(a)(8), of such Code."
        ],
        "modality_quote": "",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_text": "",
        "actor_quote": "",
        "actor": "",
        "action_quote": "possession",
        "action": "possession",
        "object_quote": "wine, beer, or distilled spirits",
        "object": "wine, beer, or distilled spirits manifested and transported as part of a shipment",
        "jurisdiction_quote": "",
        "jurisdiction": "",
        "relation": "exception",
        "references": [],
        "summary": "The prohibition against possessing wine, beer, or distilled spirits while on duty or operating a commercial motor vehicle does not apply to possession of wine, beer, or distilled spirits that are manifested and transported as part of a shipment."
      }
    },
    {
      "rationale": "Add an explicit exception unit for paragraph (a)(3)(ii) qualifying C0002, specifying that the prohibition on possessing wine, beer, or distilled spirits while on duty or operating a commercial motor vehicle does not apply when possessed or used by bus passengers.",
      "operation": "add",
      "target": "",
      "qualifies": ["C0002"],
      "quote": "(ii) Possessed or used by bus passengers.",
      "fields": {
        "concepts": [
          {
            "label": "Alcohol Possession Exception - Bus Passengers",
            "definition": "An exception to the prohibition against possessing alcoholic beverages while on duty or operating a commercial motor vehicle when the alcohol is possessed or used by bus passengers.",
            "quote": "However, this does not apply to possession of wine, beer, or distilled spirits which are:\n\n(i) Manifested and transported as part of a shipment; or\n\n(ii) Possessed or used by bus passengers.",
            "role": "rkaf:assignmentPrimary"
          }
        ],
        "claimants": [],
        "typed_values": [],
        "effective_periods": [],
        "defined_terms": [],
        "term_refs": [],
        "kind": "exception",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "However, this does not apply to possession of wine, beer, or distilled spirits which are:"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Applies as an exception to the prohibition against possessing wine, beer, or distilled spirits while on duty or operating a commercial motor vehicle.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "(3) Be on duty or operate a commercial motor vehicle while the driver possesses wine of not less than one-half of one per centum of alcohol by volume, beer as defined in 26 U.S.C. 5052(a), of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954, or distilled spirits as defined in section 5002(a)(8), of such Code."
        ],
        "modality_quote": "",

        "object": "wine, beer, or distilled spirits possessed or used by bus passengers",
        "jurisdiction_quote": "",
        "jurisdiction": "",
        "relation": "exception",
        "references": [],
        "summary": "The prohibition against possessing wine, beer, or distilled spirits while on duty or operating a commercial motor vehicle does not apply to possession of wine, beer, or distilled spirits that are possessed or used by bus passengers."
      }
    }
  ],
  "observations": [
    {
      "quote": "unless the driver chooses to request a review of the order. In this case, the driver shall report the order to the State official within 30 days of an affirmation of the order by either the Division Administrator or State Director for the geographical area or the Administrator.",
